body:
Worker trap (Termal::BarA2, 2026-10-24 07:05Z; my own miss on the Group B first_extraction diagnosis).

What happened: a failed focused run's launcher output (the bounded summary in the Bash result) showed only the first 3 lines of a test's panic list. The full panic listed 6 lines. I fixed 3, and the next run (test-eb017375) failed on the other 3, which cost a cold 10-minute rerun.

Rule: before diagnosing a failed run, read the failing test's complete panic text from the run's full log, focused.log in the RUN directory. Use grep -A on the panic message. Never rely on the summary's excerpt. For list-style assertions (such as the first_extraction boundary test), check the fix offline first by mirroring the assertion with a script. Example: .tmp/scripts-11466/machinery-scan.mjs, which reproduces no_file_outside_the_component_names_a_function_of_the_check_machinery.
